affected.note: Up to 58,124 people per Jiji Press: card data of 8,794 purchasers (2020-07-28 to 2021-12-20) leaked, plus possible leak of member data of up to 46,614 people and phone-order data of 2,716 people. Mynavi reported different figures (9,106 card records and 49,330 personal records).

summary.en: Sankyo Shokai reported that its fashion e-commerce site was breached through a vulnerability and its payment application was tampered with. Card data of 8,794 customers leaked, and personal data of up to about 58,000 people in total may have been exposed.
summary.ja: 三京商会は、ファッション通販サイト「三京商会 公式ショップ」が脆弱性を突かれ、決済アプリケーションを改ざんされたと公表した。8,794人分のカード情報が漏えいし、合計で最大約5万8,000人分の個人情報が流出した可能性がある。
